scope: Read-only source/assembly diagnosis; no source edits, builds or benchmark runs.

exact_steady_state_instruction_accountin.conditions: Valid allocated nonresident page, nonblocking request, warm dynamic bindings, no retry/error branches. Includes executed alignment nops. Two indirect call instructions are in the local74; virtual wrapper and resolved PLT jumps are in callee counts.

components: Cache already checks alignment and directory bounds in main. The unmasked async-load profile adds allocator_page_valid before deciding whether a missing page can return STATUS_BUSY.

allocator_page_valid invokes virtual get_config, repeats page alignment with DIV, masks the extent base, rejects the entire first extent and out-of-capacity addresses, invokes virtual get_refcount, then checks for nonzero allocation reference.

rc_allocator_get_ref checks allocator/config/refcount-buffer pointers, extent capacity/alignment, and extent number. Its one DIV supplies both quotient and remainder. It then performs one relaxed atomic refcount load, without a locked read-modify-write, pin, allocation, disk I/O, or sleep.

The valid miss therefore executes three DIV instructions in async-load versus one in main: cache page alignment, allocator page alignment, allocator extent quotient/remainder. The selected cache mask changes only the first; the other two are allocator work.

Main already executes allocator_page_valid via clockcache_assert_page_access_valid when admitting an actual load. The new semantic cost is validating an absent nonblocking request before returning BUSY, not introducing membership validation to every real load.

options.assessment: Recommended unless production profiling shows this path is material. The measured extra cost is approximately5.5ns per valid absent nonblocking request, with no additional miss instructions in async-load versus original.

options.option: Cache-local membership helper using already checked geometry
options.assessment: Possible after explicitly asserting allocator/cache page size, extent geometry/mask, and allocator config capacity versus get_capacity agreement at initialization, and preserving immutable geometry. After cache_try_lookup validates shape/bounds, compute extent base, reject every address in extent0, and call the existing checked allocator_get_refcount once. This can remove get_config and repeated page alignment/capacity work without rc_allocator casts. It is not a justified drop-in under the current generic init interface, which does not enforce those agreements. Preserve failure diagnostics and AL_NO_REFS=1 as allocated. The allocator get_ref DIV/checks remain.

A new allocator op could combine geometry and refcount validation once, returning false rather than asserting for untrusted addresses. This is the clean abstraction for larger savings but broadens the allocator interface, implementation and tests; not necessary for this bounded cache patch.

options.option: Cache positive allocation results or access rc_allocator fields directly
options.assessment: Reject: a cached positive refcount becomes stale across free/reallocation, and direct map access bypasses allocator safety/lifetime checks and couples cache to a particular allocator.

options.option: Return BUSY before validation for nonblocking requests
options.assessment: Reject: violates the documented BAD_PARAM/null/no-reference behavior for invalid or unallocated addresses, including nonblocking get.

options.option: Devirtualize allocator wrappers or remove PLT indirection
options.assessment: General allocator/linkage optimization affecting more than this cache path; retain existing dispatch/ABI for the bounded patch.

production_relevance.source_scan: All production .c cache_get calls parsed for the third argument; these are the only calls whose argument is not TRUE.
production_relevance.behavior: Each BUSY result requests single-page prefetch and returns WOULD_BLOCK. Btree prefetch fill stops on WOULD_BLOCK, and priming retries on subsequent scan progress. It is not a tight nonblocking retry loop per tuple.
production_relevance.limitation: The isolated miss probe deliberately keeps valid pages evicted and never prefetches them. It characterizes maximum repeated CPU validation cost, not steady-state scan throughput. Background compaction may scan, so this is not proof of zero insertion impact; no new call-frequency profile was collected.

important_semantics: Reject the whole reserved first extent, not only byte address0.
Reference value1 (AL_NO_REFS) still means allocated; only0 is free.
Validation is a snapshot; the caller must keep the extent allocated during get and handle lifetime.
Allocator refcount pointer/range/alignment checks are security boundaries; do not remove globally because one cache caller prevalidated geometry.
Cache cfg.capacity is RAM capacity, not the allocator disk capacity.
